title: Endpoint-Regular Fixed-Point Universality
abstract: For uniformly endpoint-regularly varying terminal rate arrays, this paper proves a logarithmic Poisson point process for fixed points, identifies the fixed-point factorial moments and mean constant, and derives endpoint displacement, mesoscopic tangent-measure, multiplicative-kernel, and microscopic endpoint-permutation limits. The proof develops endpoint-specific saddle geometry, anisotropic local limits, mixed localization, and covariance stability.
